title: The Trinity test as the hinge point that drew the phenomenon

tellings.quote: unable to destroy itself. Then on July 16th, 1945, in a stretch of New Mexico desert, Oenheimer named Trinity.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to July 16, 1945, when the physicist Robert Oppenheimer's team set off Trinity, the first atomic bomb test, in the New Mexico desert. Michels frames that test as the turning point that drew the UFO phenomenon to us. If true, it would mean the visitors showed up because humanity had just gained the power to destroy itself.
